Package org.see.skf.core

Interface SKFederate

All Known Implementing Classes:
SEEAbstractFederate, SKAbstractFederate
public interface SKFederate

The root interface for all SEE HLA Starter Kit federates. The interface wraps around many of the methods provided by the RTIAmbassador class and additionally offers specific functionality such as managing object instances and callback listeners.

The framework includes two implementations: SKAbstractFederate and SEEAbstractFederate. SEE teams are recommended to use the SEEAbstractFederate class as the starting point for their federates as it is a fully SRFOM-compliant late joiner implementation.

Since:
2.0

    • createObjectInstance

      Future<Void> createObjectInstance(Object objectInstance, String name)
      Creates a named HLA object instance using the ObjectClass annotation attached to the provided object. Since name reservation requires an RTI callback that is not immediately delivered, this operation does not finish in the same time step. Use Future.get() or Future.isDone() on the returned Future object to ensure that it has completed without incident before performing any object instance-related operations.
      Parameters:
      objectInstance - The object to be used to represent this HLA object instance
      name - Name to be assigned to the object instance
      Returns:
      A future object for tracking the completion of this operation

    • updateObjectInstance

      void updateObjectInstance(Object objectInstance, String... attributes) throws hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.FederateNotExecutionMember, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.RestoreInProgress, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.AttributeNotOwned, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.NotConnected, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.RTIinternalError, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.SaveInProgress, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.AttributeNotDefined, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.ObjectInstanceNotKnown

      Updates the specified attributes on the specified object instance. The updated values will be delivered to subscribing federates. The federate must own all the specified attributes. The values are translated into raw byte arrays through the coders assigned to the Attribute annotated fields of the object.

      The absence of any attributes supplied to this method will elicit an update for all the object's values.

      Parameters:
      objectInstance - The object that is being used to represent this HLA object instance
      attributes - Names of the attributes to be updated
      Throws:
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.FederateNotExecutionMember
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.RestoreInProgress
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.AttributeNotOwned
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.NotConnected

      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.SaveInProgress
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.AttributeNotDefined
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.ObjectInstanceNotKnown

    • sendInteraction

      void sendInteraction(Object interaction) throws hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.FederateNotExecutionMember, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.RestoreInProgress, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.NotConnected, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.RTIinternalError, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.SaveInProgress, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.InteractionClassNotDefined, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.InteractionClassNotPublished, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.InteractionParameterNotDefined

      Sends the specified parameters and their specified values that subscribe to the specified interaction class or any superclass. The receiving interaction class will be the specified interaction class, if subscribed, or the closest subscribed superclass. Any parameters defined on a subclass will not be delivered. The sending federate is not required to provide all parameters that are defined on the specified interaction class. The RTI will not provide any default values for parameters that are not part of this operation.

      The values are translated into raw byte arrays through the coders assigned to the Parameter annotated fields of the object.

      Parameters:
      interaction - The object that is being used to represent this HLA interaction

    • queryAttributeOwnership

      Future<Map<String,String>> queryAttributeOwnership(String objectInstanceName, String... attributeNames)

      Requests a report on the ownership of the specified attributes. Since the outcome of this operation is asynchronous and the results are not immediately available, a Future is returned. It is advised to call Future.get() in a separate thread to block until a result is returned or call Future.isDone() in each time step until the result becomes available.

      Parameters:
      objectInstanceName - Name of the object instance that is the target of this query
      attributeNames - Names of the attributes whose ownership is to be queried
      Returns:
      A map consisting of attribute name to the federate name as the key-value pair

    • acquireAttributeOwnership

      void acquireAttributeOwnership(String objectInstanceName, String... attributeNames) throws hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.FederateNotExecutionMember, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.ObjectClassNotPublished, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.AttributeNotDefined, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.RestoreInProgress, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.FederateOwnsAttributes, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.ObjectInstanceNotKnown, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.NotConnected, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.RTIinternalError, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.AttributeNotPublished, hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.SaveInProgress

      Initiates an acquisition sequence. The specified attributes fall into one of three categories: Unowned attributes will become immediately owned by this federate. Attributes that are part of a negotiated divestiture will require the owning federate to confirm the divestiture. Owned attributes that are not part of a divestiture will have to release ownership at their discretion.

      The federate is notified of the outcome of the attribute acquisition sequence through any AttributeOwnershipListener objects that were registered with the federate.

      Parameters:
      objectInstanceName - Name of the object instance
      attributeNames - Names of the attributes whose ownership is of interest to this federate
      Throws:
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.FederateNotExecutionMember
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.ObjectClassNotPublished
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.AttributeNotDefined
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.RestoreInProgress
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.FederateOwnsAttributes
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.ObjectInstanceNotKnown
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.NotConnected
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.RTIinternalError
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.AttributeNotPublished
      hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.SaveInProgress
